gold_note: 30 tips. Chasmosaurinae is a collapsed clade and keeps its printed text. CPC_279 is printed on a dashed branch with a "?" from the Xenoceratops node; it is not in the matrix and is kept here as a member of that polytomy with its printed name, so drop it if the benchmark should score only solid branches. "MOR 692 Avaceratops" and "CMN 8804 Avaceratops" are Avaceratops_sp._MOR_692 and Avaceratops_sp._CMN_8804 in the matrix.
